notes.title: Orange Update for September - A Little Extra Juice
notes.content:
Halloo! This Orange Update contains a few Quality of Life enhancements, aesthetic touches, some camera trickery, and the usual bug-hunt. Protag’s Dream Mode got a few big adjustments, the main one being that if you die on that first round with Weary, you don’t get bumped all the way back to the title screen anymore – the dream simply starts over. I find this adjustment makes replaying that mode less obnoxious. I could POSSIBLY do that set-up for Iron Orange Mode as well, as the reset only happens on the first round.

Changes and Fixes:

 ‘Protag’s Nightmare’ now starts over immediately if you die on the first round
 Weary dialogue was still not functioning quite right, should be fixed now. Also an extra line of dialogue added
 Some new camera views exclusively for ‘Protag’s Dream’. I may set the alternate camera angles as an option for all modes
 Been doing a makeover on the apples, a work in progress, new animations added hither and tither


More to come as we peel further into the story!

notes.title: Orangey Update for August – Rearranging the Decor a little, Chasing Bugs
notes.content:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45207504/7bc0140eea8bbce3f1922d7c476e30d06f8e3b53.png"]

Halloo! Besides a bunch of new graphical elements, there is a SUPA-SECRET build of Orange Roulette that contains the first swing at LOCAL TWO PLAYER. It is in a separate Beta Build that can be accessed by right-clicking on the Orange Roulette icon in your game library, going to properties and choosing ‘Betas’, and then selecting for Beta Participation:


orangetesting1 – Testing branch



and entering the password:




thefruitofthepoorlemon




The Two-Player is in ‘Royale Mode’ and is currently the only choice in the Beta.

I’ll explain this further in the game discussion and answer questions/comments! Currently you can only play the ‘OG’ Roulette in two-player – YOU SPIN OTHER. The specials will be added soon as UI is completed for choosing round type.


Changes and Fixes:




- some major visual enhancements made to ‘Protag’s Nightmare’

- a new batch of random clothing additions to ‘Protag’s Nightmare’

- sometimes the end screen for Royale Mode would glitch when Player wins, should be fixed
- some new decorations in the main game modes 
- a few adjustments to game controller support
- The first peek at Local Two Player is online in a Beta build


As usual, I did a bunch of new coding, so let me know of anything weird that happen!
More stuff rolling in soon!

notes.title: Quicky Wee Fix Update 6/25
notes.content:
Fixed pressing the spacebar putting players alone in the cell for some reason
 Made some logic fixes
 Fixed a bug that made Protag's Doppelganger in Protag Dream sometimes have a teeny face that was running all around his head. Yes it was hilarious. Fix will hopefully solve a couple other reported problems with odd character behavior. 

The new mode update has a lot of fresh stuff going on under the hood, so I'll be keeping an eye on it and working to fix reported bugs and whatever I personally stumble across!

notes.title: Orangey Update for June – An Orange Blightmare
notes.content:
Halloo! I have finally achieved the release version of Orange Roulette 1.7.0! A new mode is introduced, really the first chapter of ‘Plus Mode’, which will contain additional character stories and game variations in the future, but for now is the recurring sticky nightmare of Protag. He can’t even get away in his dreams, but he’s starting to think there might be help out there somewhere.

Changes and Fixes:


 Plus Mode is activated, with the first new chapter of the Orange saga
 new items introduced into the chaos of a bad dream
 some new animations
 a new move is introduced by Weary, which may be important someday
 several shakeups of game variation
 a little secret functionality to Easy Mode to keep things interesting
 new achievements for Plus Mode plus a saved high-score for same


I did a whole lot of new coding, so lemme know if anything anomalous happens, besides what’s supposed to happen of course!

notes.title: Update Notes for May 5th, Say Hello to Weary
notes.content:
Orangey Update for May – an Orange’s Return, Spring Cleaning, Getting it Ready 1.63

Halloo! I wanted to reveal new changes and additions to Orange Roulette as I finish play-testing and preparing the first of the plus modes. The major addition is a new orange joining the lineup, a character from long, long ago, now returned. Where did he go? Did he escape? Why is he back? To help or hinder? Time will tell!
Changes and Fixes:

 A new mysterious orange has been added to the roster, and can be currently found hiding in Iron Orange, where you can get the achievement for defeating him, and in Orange Royale
 Some few new accessories added to some characters
 New character animations
 Crazy gets a new do
 Crazy’s logic changed slightly … basically he has no logic, and is truly random. Also not a fan of special moves
 A new bonus option has been added to Orange Royale – the ‘Long Spin’. The cylinder will keep spinning for about 10 seconds, and you can pull the trigger on your opponent at any time. Try your luck at guessing the exact moment to pull the trigger! If you miss, your next trigger pull is on yourself
 The bonus option ‘Lucky Horshoe’ has been clarified with a handy visual aid showing where in the cylinder the deadly banana bullet resides. An ‘X’ marks the spot where the next trigger pull is lethal
 End game stats added to Orange Royale

Thank you for your patience as I add these segments of my dream list for Orange Roulette. New Mode coming soon!

notes.title: Orange Update 1/28/25
notes.content:
Halloo! Current update adds additional logic and extra rules for Grim Mode.

 When Grim is losing, he may change the game rules for a single round in the hopes of evening the odds
 Slight change to Grim logic so he doesn't put himself in a 'bad luck spiral'
 Added animations for Grim

notes.title: A Grim Update 1/8/25
notes.content:
In the new year of 2025, we present our first new update! It contains the following:


 Revamp of Grim Orange round for all modes - singular sign above player has been replaced with ghostly signs for both Protag Orange and Grim, so you both know what the next major option is. Very useful for a little strategy
 Added the ghosts of defeated oranges in the Grim Round, as some may remember from the original Flash game - they move quick but they are there
 Found a sneaky little bug in Grim Battle that is now fixed
 Grim rules are now handily posted on a board hung on the rear wall. Consult to know what's what
 Blood Orange now has a blood trail  
 Fixed a little music bug

Welcome to the scary new year, next update coming soon!

notes.title: Orange Update 11/10/24 - The Company Store Update
notes.content:
The Apples supply one(1) Company Store Dollar for winning a round in Orange Royale. This can be used to purchase one of two extra move options. Only one(1) dollar is issued at a time, does not stack.
Several new environmental effects have been added to all modes.
Lucky Horseshoe! Purely for decoration in all modes but Royale, where it can serve a purpose.
Gamepad controls should be available for the entire game, including title screen
A few sfx adjustments.
Gun pass coding changed slightly. Formally set to frame rate, it is now independent of that. I noticed it changing rotation in YouTube videos, it should now be consistent.
Two new achievements!
